# overlay

```go [overlay.go]
import "github.com/gettako/tako/internal/ui/overlay"
```

Package overlay provides the OverlayManager implementation for the Tako framework. It is the single high\-level DX facade for all layer management: basic overlays, component overlays, and dialog primitives.

<a name="Manager"></a>
## type [Manager](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/ui/overlay/manager.go#L25-L32>)

Manager implements \[contracts.OverlayManager\]. It is the single high\-level entry point for layer management in Tako.

- Basic overlays: Show / Close / CloseAll / Top / IsActive
- Component overlays: Register / ShowComponent
- Dialog primitives: Dialog\(\) → DialogService

Obtain via app.Overlay\(\) or ctx.Overlay\(\).

```go [manager.go]

    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="NewManager"></a>
### func [NewManager](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/ui/overlay/manager.go#L38>)

```go [manager.go]
func NewManager(r *router.Router, h hook.Registry, bus contracts.EventBus) *Manager
```

NewManager creates a new OverlayManager, including its embedded DialogService. The circular reference between Manager and dialog.Service is resolved via two\-phase init: the Service is created first \(with a nil overlay reference\), then the Manager is created and wired back.

<a name="Manager.Close"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [Close](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/ui/overlay/manager.go#L97>)

```go [manager.go]
func (m *Manager) Close()
```

Close pops the topmost overlay from the stack and reverts keyboard focus to the layer below.

If the stack is already at the base layer \(size == 1\), Close is a no\-op.

Emits: "overlay:closed" with the closed layer ID as data.

<a name="Manager.CloseAll"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [CloseAll](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/ui/overlay/manager.go#L118>)

```go [manager.go]
func (m *Manager) CloseAll()
```

CloseAll pops every overlay down to \(but not including\) the base layer.

Emits "overlay:closed" for each layer that is dismissed.

<a name="Manager.Dialog"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [Dialog](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/ui/overlay/manager.go#L182>)

```go [manager.go]
func (m *Manager) Dialog() contracts.DialogService
```

Dialog returns the \[contracts.DialogService\] for this overlay manager, providing common interaction primitives \(confirm, alert, prompt, etc.\).

Dialogs are specialized overlays — they are pushed and dismissed through the same stack managed by this OverlayManager.

Usage:

```
app.Overlay().Dialog().Confirm("Delete?", func(yes bool) { ... })

// Cache for multiple calls:
d := ctx.Overlay().Dialog()
d.Confirm("Step 1?", cb1)
```

<a name="Manager.Register"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [Register](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/ui/overlay/manager.go#L143>)

```go [manager.go]
func (m *Manager) Register(c contracts.Component)
```

Register wires the component's render hook and keybindings without pushing it onto the stack. Use this to pre\-register a component before its layer becomes active. Prefer ShowComponent for the common case.

<a name="Manager.Show"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [Show](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/ui/overlay/manager.go#L67>)

```go [manager.go]
func (m *Manager) Show(layerID string, render func() any)
```

Show pushes layerID onto the focus stack, registers render as the hook provider under "tako.overlay.\<layerID\>", and shifts keyboard focus to the new layer.

Calling Show when layerID is already the top layer is a no\-op to prevent duplicate stack entries.

Emits: "overlay:shown" with layerID as data.

<a name="Manager.ShowComponent"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [ShowComponent](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/ui/overlay/manager.go#L162>)

```go [manager.go]
func (m *Manager) ShowComponent(c contracts.Component)
```

ShowComponent wires the component \(hook \+ keybindings\) and immediately pushes it onto the overlay stack, shifting keyboard focus to it. Equivalent to Register\(c\) followed by Show\(c.ID\(\), c.Render\).

<a name="Manager.Top"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [Top](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/ui/overlay/manager.go#L126>)

```go [manager.go]
func (m *Manager) Top() string
```

Top returns the ID of the currently active overlay, or an empty string if no overlay is active \(i.e. the stack has only the base layer\).
